notes.subject: telwit
notes.rationale: Calom (שלום) yugar talwit: d timmalelt, d talwit, d lɛafya; yerna awal-a yiwen ur izmir ara ad ifek akk inumak-is

notes.subject: mḥolal
notes.rationale: meḥolal: 'yettwajedɛer' (ḍeffir-neɣ) neɣ 'yettwaḥercem / yettwakred'; yerna anamek-agi yettwaḥettem ɣef lmuqeddem n Maciaḥ

notes.subject: illa
notes.rationale: Taɛbranit ur tesɛi ara afux 'yella' deg nnideg-a; yettwarna iwakken ad yili d taɣeṛiṣṭ n umeslugen

notes.subject: meḥukkar / ḥavonot
notes.rationale: Sin n yismawen yettemcabin n taɣerṣiṭṭa (meḥolal/meḍukkar, peceʕenu/ʿavonotenu) i d-yettmeslayen deg uḍris; taɛejjeb-agi ur tettwazmir ara deg tsuqilt

translation: Yerna netta yettwaḥercem ɣef trezɣa-nneɣ, yettwaggez ɣef tucḍiwin-nneɣ; asteɛriḍ n telwit-nneɣ illa fell-as, d ⟨lweḥǧa⟩ n lbeṭṭa-nneɣ i neḥla.
